from typing import Any

_EVENT_NAME = "auto_escalate"
_DATE_FORMAT = "%Y%m%d"


def _datediff(d1: Any, d2: Any) -> int:
    """Return whole calendar days d1 - d2 using legacy sentinel semantics."""
    left = "" if d1 is None else str(d1)
    right = "" if d2 is None else str(d2)

    if left in ("", "00000000") or right in ("", "00000000"):
        return 0

    left_date = datetime.strptime(left, _DATE_FORMAT).date()
    right_date = datetime.strptime(right, _DATE_FORMAT).date()
    return (left_date - right_date).days


def escalate(cases: list[dict], today: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return ordered auto-escalation workflow events for overdue live cases."""

    emitted_case_ids: set[str] = set()

        key=lambda case: "" if case.get("CASE_ID") is None else str(case["CASE_ID"]),

        open_date = case.get("OPEN_DT", "")
